summary: TIM S.A. filed a 6-K attaching minutes of its Fiscal Council meeting held September 17, 2026, which endorsed management's proposal to distribute interest on shareholders' equity of R$515,000,000 (R$0.2166801148 gross per share), payable by January 22, 2027, with a September 22, 2026 record date and 17.5% withholding tax. The council also received presentations on FUST/FUNTTEL tax contingency controls and whistleblowing-channel statistics. This is a routine dividend-equivalent capital distribution and governance update by a Brazilian foreign private issuer, not a special situation; no transaction, stake, or board recommendation on a deal is involved.
